    How to read this

    State averages, and the US average for readmissions, are simple averages of every reporting hospital, calculated by this site. Other US figures are Medicare's published national rates. Hospitals with too few cases have no result for that measure and are left out of averages and rankings. Hospital details and star ratings come from the Hospital General Information file, July 2026.
